notes.title: Our new game The Wandering Village just launched on Kickstarter!
notes.content:
Dear Drone Engineers,

We just launched the Kickstarter campaign for our next game: The Wandering Village!
The Wandering Village is a brand-new city-building simulation game where you build a settlement on the back of a giant, wandering creature. Have a look at our trailer to get a feeling what the game is about:

[previewyoutube=1VsBOgA7RZk;full][/previewyoutube]
About the game
Mysterious plants are spreading all over the earth, emitting toxic spores as they grow. 
A group of people seeks shelter on the back of a giant, wandering creature. Becoming their leader, players build both their settlement and a symbiotic relationship with the gentle beast to survive together in this hostile, yet beautiful post-apocalyptic world that now surrounds them.

For more information about the game please visit the Steam page and don't forget to wishlist it <3

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1121640/The_Wandering_Village/

Kickstarter
Like we did with our other games Niche and Nimbatus we are launching a Kickstarter campaign for The Wandering Village where you can support us and get some awesome rewards in return! The campaign will be live for the next 30 days, please make sure to check it out :)

We also set up a new Discord server for the game. Come and join us to share your ideas about the game, chat with us and meet other fans! 

Cheers & Thanks
Stray Fawn Studio

notes.title: Nimbatus 1.1 Update
notes.content:
​Dear Drone Engineers,

We just released a new update! We looked through all the features that you suggested and upvoted in our forums and picked the ones that we liked most and were within our time limit.

The two most notable changes are the new multiselection feature that let's you select and edit multiple drone parts at once by pressing CTRL. And the dronepart template system where you can create templates and use them accross your drones. 
 
Discount and Drone Building Contest
To celebrate the update the full game Nimbatus - The Space Drone Constructor is 25% off for the next two weeks!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/383840/Nimbatus__The_Space_Drone_Constructor/

Also we are running a drone building contest in our Discord, where you can win Steam keys for Nimbatus. Head over to our Discord to participate!

We are also running a giveaway on Twitter where you can win a Steam key for the full game!

Patchnotes 1.1.2
New Features
 Drone Part Multiselection: Press Ctrl and click on multiple drone parts or press CTRL and drag a rectangle to select multiple parts. If the parts are of the same type you can edit them all at once.
 Drone Part Templates: You can create templates of drone parts, store them and use them when building different drones.
 New Tutorials to learn magnets and tags
 Exit without save button for the drone workshop

New Drone Parts
 Wheels
 Grappling Hook
 Ballast Tank

Improvements
 Added linear option for springs,  this allows for better suspension for wheels


Cheers,
Stray Fawn Studio

notes.title: Drone Building Contest - Second Round!
notes.content:
Dear Drone Engineers,

We got some awesome submissions for the first Drone Building Contest! You can see a list of all the winners in our forums

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37033396/890f8ad1219d89d1b34a61c35fb9a136b3fdc3b2.gif

New Drone Building Contest - Win Steam Keys
Since the first competition, many new players have downloaded and played the Nimbatus Drone Creator. That's why we start a brand-new Drone Building Contest today! The deadline to enter a drone is May 19th. Winners will receive 1 of 3 Steam keys for the full game! (Nimbatus - The Space Drone Constructor)

Here is how you can enter the building competition:  Build the smartest, coolest looking or most creative drone using the Nimbatus Drone Creator.
 Create a GIF of the drone (press F9 to create a GIF of the last 10 seconds in the game) or record one otherwise.
 Post your GIF in one of these places to enter the competition:
- In our Forum
- On our Discord
- Or share it on Twitter with #DroneCreator

We hope you enjoy the Drone Creator and wish you good luck in the competition!

Cheers,
​​​​​​​Stray Fawn Studio

notes.title: Nimbatus - Drone Creator Release & Building Competition!
notes.content:
Dear Drone Engineers,

We just released the Nimbatus Drone Creator! ːsteamhappyː
The Drone Creator is the standalone drone editor from Nimbatus - The Space Drone Constructor. You can build and test drones using the full range of drone parts from the full game.

[previewyoutube=bBNPk3wZ7UE;full][/previewyoutube]
To celebrate the release, we host a drone building competition!  The deadline to enter a drone is May 7th. Winners will be announced shortly after and will receive 1 of 3 Steam keys for the full game (Nimbatus - The Space Drone Constructor)!

Here is how you can enter the building competition:
- Build the smartest, coolest looking or most creative drone ever.
- Create a GIF of the drone (press F9 to create a GIF of the last 10 seconds in the game) or record one otherwise.
- Post your creation in this thread in our forums, or on our Discord or share them on Twitter with #DroneCreator to enter the competition

We hope you enjoy the Drone Creator and build many awesome things with it!

​Cheers,
Stray Fawn Studio
